label: rem:categorical-reeb-derivation-remark
title: The Reeb derivation, observer drift and the discrete spectrum
html: The derivation \xi_q preserves the contact structure on the state bundle \mathcal{S} and encodes the observer drift. The periodicity condition \xi_q^{\Omega_q} = \mathrm{id}_A ensures that the Reeb flow closes, yielding a discrete spectrum of frequencies on A; each eigenvalue of \xi_q corresponds to a fundamental mode of the substrate.
heading: Remark
